title: Expired Domain Quality Score
when: Use after hunter.py finds a domain - paste Spamzilla + Wayback data

title: Niche Keyword Expander - CAD/Audio/DR40
prompt: I hunt expired domains for {{facility: CAD Facility / Audio Facility / Daily DR40}}. Seed keywords: {{seed_keywords}}. Expand to 50 long-tail keywords that REAL businesses would use, not SEO spam. Exclude 'seo', 'pbn', 'casino', 'crypto'. Group by intent: brand, service, location. Return as CSV.

title: Spamzilla CSV Cleaner
prompt: Clean this Spamzilla CSV: {{paste_csv_rows}}. Rules: 1) Drop any domain containing seoexpress, seo, pbn, casino, essay, loan 2) Keep only DR>=25 3) Add column 'wayback_quality' - if <3 snapshots = LIKELY SPAM 4) Add column 'notes' - REAL SITE vs LIKELY SPAM. Return cleaned CSV with same headers + 2 new columns.

title: Domain Flip Outreach Email
prompt: Write a 4-sentence outreach to sell {{domain}} to a {{buyer_type: CAD shop, audio studio, etc}}. History: {{wayback_summary}}. DR: {{dr}} Backlinks: {{backlinks}}. Don't sound like a spammer. Mention real history, why it's a fit, price range {{price}}, and easy transfer. Casual but professional.

title: PBN & Promo Spam Detector
prompt: Analyze this site content: {{paste_text_or_urls}}. Is it 'seoexpress' promo spam? Check for: repeated 'best SEO services' templates, same author across sites, fake testimonials, <5 pages of thin content. Return: SPAM / CLEAN and 3 evidence bullets. Example bad: audioproductionhub.com

title: Backlink Profile Human Summary
prompt: Summarize this backlink profile for a non-SEO client: Domain {{domain}} - DR {{dr}} - Backlinks {{count}} - Top referring: {{domains}} - Anchors: {{anchors}}. Write 3 bullets: Strength, Risk (spam?), Opportunity. No jargon.

title: Wayback Quality Explainer
prompt: Explain Wayback snapshot count: Domain {{domain}} has {{count}} snapshots from {{years}}. Translate: 2 snapshots = parked spam, 80 snapshots over 10 years = real business that died. Give verdict and what to check next in Archive.org.
when: You were confused on visits vs saves - this clarifies

title: Fix 'No event triggers defined in on' YAML
prompt: My GitHub Actions YAML fails with 'No event triggers defined in on': {{paste_yaml}}. Fix indentation, ensure 'on:' has workflow_dispatch and schedule. Return minimal working YAML that ALWAYS parses, with LF, no smart quotes. Include collision-proof file names: daily-*.csv, cad-*.csv, audio-*.csv
when: Exact error you hit on hunt.yml

title: Desktop Bypass for Broken Web Editor
prompt: I keep getting YAML parse errors in GitHub website editor. Give me GitHub Desktop steps to: 1) Delete .github folder 2) Recreate workflows folder 3) Drag clean files 4) Commit with 'fix: final' 5) Push. Keep it bullet-proof for indents.

title: n8n Workflow from Idea
prompt: Turn this idea into an n8n workflow: {{idea}}. Nodes needed: {{Trigger, HTTP Request, Filter, CSV, GitHub}}. Handle rate limits, deduplication, and auto-commit. Return node-by-node steps + JSON I can import.
when: Build automation kits like your AutomationCentral ones

title: Scraper Code Review - Requests/BS4
prompt: Review this scraper: {{paste_python}}. Stack: requests + BeautifulSoup + lxml. Check: 1) Spam filter 2) Wayback CDX API call 3) Collision handling 4) CSV writing. Be blunt - what would break at 1000 domains? Suggest 3 fixes.

title: Cron Collision Debugger
prompt: Two workflows write same file {{filename}} at {{time}} and collide. Daily, CAD, Audio all run 7-9am. Fix: suggest unique file naming (daily-{{date}}.csv) and concurrency groups. Return fixed YAML snippet.
when: Why Daily + CAD failed but Audio worked

title: Faceless Content Script from Domain Niche
prompt: Domain niche: {{niche: CAD, audio production, etc}}. History: {{wayback_summary}}. Write a 30-second faceless video script: Hook (problem), 3 tips from old site content, CTA to check {{domain}}. No face needed, just voiceover + B-roll suggestions.

title: Etsy Shop Description from Domain
prompt: Create Etsy shop launch kit from this expired domain: {{domain}} - old titles: {{titles}}. Output: Shop name, 3 product ideas, description (human, not AI), 13 tags. Style: {{vibe}}

title: YouTube Data Accuracy Checker
prompt: I have YouTube data: {{paste_data}}. Check accuracy: compare views, upload dates, and transcripts vs actual video {{url}}. Flag mismatches and likely cause (scrape delay, shorts vs long). Return clean table.

title: Facebook Reach Recovery Audit
prompt: My Facebook page {{page_name}} reach dropped. Recent posts: {{paste_posts}}. Analyze: posting time, link vs native, engagement bait, repost frequency. Give 3 fixes to recover reach this week, no 'buy ads' generic advice.

title: LinkedIn Lead Scraper Cleanup
prompt: Clean these LinkedIn leads: {{paste_csv}}. Remove duplicates, fake titles, students. Add column 'personalized_opener' referencing {{their_post_or_company}}. Return outreach-ready CSV + 2-sentence DM template that doesn't sound like automation.

title: 6-Kit Offer Builder (AutomationCentral Style)
prompt: Turn this skill into 6 kit offers like AutomationCentral.online: Skill {{skill}}. Create carousel titles: 'LinkedIn Lead Scraping', 'Faceless Content Assets', etc. Each: problem, what's inside, who it's for. Price tier $19-49.

title: Landing Page Copy for Digital Kit
prompt: Write landing page for kit: {{kit_name}}. Audience: {{audience}}. Promise: {{promise}}. Sections: Hero (pain), What's Inside (bullets), Who's it for / Not for, FAQ (2 Qs). Tone: direct, no hype, like you talk.

title: Messy Notes to GitHub Issues
prompt: Turn these messy notes into GitHub issues: {{paste_notes}}. Each issue: title, description, label (bug/enhancement), priority (high/mid/low), checklist. Group related notes.

title: Firm But Chill Client Reply
prompt: Client says: '{{client_message}}' Context: {{context - e.g., hunt.yml failing 3x}}. Write reply: acknowledge waste of time, own fix, give clear next step (GitHub Desktop bypass), set boundary. Tone: not corporate, not angry. 4 sentences max.
when: When you're getting annoyed but need to stay professional

title: YouTube Transcript to Action Plan
prompt: Summarize this transcript: {{paste_transcript_or_url}} Into: 5 bullets, 1 action plan (do today), 1 code snippet or tool to try. Skip intro fluff. Keep it tactical.

title: De-AI My Writing
prompt: Rewrite this to not sound like AI: {{paste_text}}. Rules: short sentences, contractions, one typo-level imperfection ok, no em dashes, no 'delve' 'leverage' 'unlock'. Keep meaning. Make it sound like you texted it.

title: Daily Hunter Report Generator
prompt: I have hunter outputs: {{paste_csv_summary_or_files}}. Generate daily report: Total domains found, breakdown by facility (daily/cad/audio), top 5 by DR, spam filtered count, wayback avg, and 3 next actions. Format for GitHub commit message + Slack.
